competing_explanation: The 30-day figure may be outdated, category-specific, or refer to a different refund/return policy rather than the current standard-item full-refund window.
hypothesis_statement: The current policy provides a 30-day full-refund return window for standard items, measured from delivery or receipt.
predicted_outcome: H_P is supported: the correct current window is 30 days for standard items.
refutation_criterion: Authoritative current policy evidence shows the full-refund window for standard items is not 30 days, or that standard items are excluded from full refunds within 30 days.
